summary: Backend + frontend testing of canonical Lead-score ranking, sort modes (lead_score / freshness / confidence), /top, /top-by-lane, NBA, and the CRITICAL Hunt-status guardrail regression from iteration_6. 15/15 backend pytest cases PASS. All frontend sort interactions work and UI ordering matches API exactly across the three modes; Command Center top-opps prefix matches /api/opportunities/top perfectly (6/6 IDs). The iteration_6 CRITICAL bug (Hunt status='Rejected' not blocking approve+send) is FIXED — POST /api/leads/{id}/action now returns 422 with 'Blocked by Hunt status=...' and no email is sent. LEADS_FIELD_MAP correctly includes 'Hunt status' → 'hunt_status' (leads_service.py:42). Priority score is now cleaned Airtable Lead score (float or None); unscored records rank LAST in lead_score & confidence modes, dateless records rank LAST in freshness mode. NOTE: The previously-used test lead rec1j1S6sVvAu0ofb is no longer accessible in Airtable (403 INVALID_PERMISSIONS_OR_MODEL_NOT_FOUND). Switched to rec9oACK2PGWSmfmk (Greige Interiors) which is the current NBA pick.

minor.issue: Still only resets opportunity_service singleton; leads_service is orphaned. The hunt-status test had to fall back to `sudo supervisorctl restart backend` to force a cache bust because the leads-service TTL is 45s. Iteration_6 called this out as well — not yet addressed.
Previous test lead rec1j1S6sVvAu0ofb now returns 404 (Airtable 403 on that record ID). Not a code bug — record was deleted or permissions revoked — but future tests should not hard-code this ID.

ui_bugs.issue: List-view rows have NO data-testid tied to the record id. Only the Cards view exposes data-testid=`opp-card-{id}`. Testing agents that verify ordering in the default List view have no stable per-row selector. Add data-testid=`opp-row-{id}` to OpportunityRow.

Clicking a sort button updates internal state and re-fetches, but does NOT push the selected sort to the URL as ?sort=. The spec says 'Clicking each button changes the ?sort= query param'. Fix: call setSearchParams in setSort handler so refresh/deep-link preserves the sort choice.

action_items: Add data-testid=`opp-row-{id}` to OpportunityRow so list-view ordering is testable without switching to Cards view.
Persist sort selection into URL (?sort=) via setSearchParams so refresh/deep-link preserves it, matching the spec.
Extend /api/admin/reload to also call reset_leads_service() so cache invalidation is uniform (iteration_6 follow-up, still outstanding).
Optional: expose a POST /api/admin/leads-reload if unifying isn't desired.
critical_code_review_comments: leads_service.py:42 — 'Hunt status' mapping now present. Guardrail path (line 407-411) is live and verified.
airtable_service.py:261-286 — sort_opportunities is the single source of truth for ranking. Clean implementation with scored-first / unscored-last partitioning and correct freshness DESC tie-break.

server.py:382 (/api/admin/reload) — still only resets opportunity_service. leads_service cache invalidation depends on 45s TTL, which forced the hunt-status test to restart the backend to guarantee freshness.
Opportunities.jsx:46 setSort — updates only local state, not searchParams. This diverges from the stated spec that sort should be reflected in ?sort= query param.
OpportunityRow (list view) lacks a per-row data-testid — makes list ordering untestable via stable selectors.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 tests) — including the iteration_6 critical hunt-status guardrail
success_rate.frontend: 100% for sort UI + Command Center top-opps ranking match; 2 minor UX/testability observations

test_credentials: N/A (no auth). Airtable + EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY already in backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: All mutations on rec9oACK2PGWSmfmk (Greige Interiors) are wrapped in try/finally with _restore(). Fields touched: Contact email, Hunt status, Outreach sent, Approval status, Outreach status, Status. All restored after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test lead rec1j1S6sVvAu0ofb is DEAD (403 from Airtable). Use rec9oACK2PGWSmfmk instead — it's the current NBA pick and is safe to mutate/restore. Always run pytest with `-o addopts=''` (pytest.ini enables -n xdist which races on the single Airtable lead). The hunt-status guardrail test restarts the backend to bust the 45s leads-service cache — expect ~15s of test time. Frontend Opportunities page has TWO views (List / Cards); only Cards view exposes per-row data-testid, so switch to Cards via `[data-testid=view-grid]` before asserting per-row order.
rca of the issue: iteration_6 CRITICAL bug (Hunt status guardrail dead-code) is confirmed FIXED. LEADS_FIELD_MAP at line 42 of /app/backend/services/leads_service.py now includes '"Hunt status": "hunt_status"'. As a result _record_to_dto surfaces hunt_status, can_send() sees 'Rejected', and returns {ok:False, reason:'Blocked by Hunt status=...'}. Verified end-to-end: set Hunt status='Rejected' + Contact email='delivered@resend.dev' via pyairtable, restart backend to bust cache, POST /api/leads/{id}/action {action:approve} → 422 with detail containing 'hunt status'; Outreach sent remains false; no Resend call.
